decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer was launched only in 2018, sits close to the core offer, and embodies substantial in-house R&D and public commitment, so management will attribute any slow start to ramp-up and persist with it.

The backside numbering software module supports the announced digitalization and serialization direction, costs little to keep, and builds on the established systems, so dropping it would contradict the firm's stated strategy.

The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces leverages the firm's ink expertise and was publicly launched just a year ago, so sunk development costs and its fit with the one-stop solution promise favor continuing it.
